# INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS columns and values documented by BigQuery.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/information-schema-views.md

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_definition AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT view_definition FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 'infoschema_view_definition'
=> "SELECT 1 AS x"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_options AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT check_option IS NULL AND use_standard_sql = 'YES' FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 'infoschema_view_options'
=> "true"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_path AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT table_catalog = @@project_id AND table_schema = 'scalars' FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 'infoschema_view_path'
=> "true"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 't'
=> "0"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_region AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_schema = 'scalars' AND table_name = 'infoschema_view_region'
=> "1"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_updated AS SELECT 1 AS x;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_updated AS SELECT 'updated' AS x;
SELECT view_definition FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 'infoschema_view_updated'
=> "SELECT 'updated' AS x"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_deleted AS SELECT 1 AS x;
DROP VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_deleted;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 'infoschema_view_deleted'
=> "0"

# Reading a stored definition does not resolve its table dependencies.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.infoschema_view_source (x INT64);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.infoschema_view_missing_source AS SELECT x FROM scalars.infoschema_view_source;
DROP TABLE scalars.infoschema_view_source;
SELECT view_definition FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_name = 'infoschema_view_missing_source'
=> "SELECT x FROM scalars.infoschema_view_source"
